title: Finite Gram Scalarization and Further Properties of Multiplier Submodule Sheaves
summary: Let $(E,h)$ be a singular Hermitian vector bundle on a complex manifold $X$, and let \[ \mathcal E(h)_x=\{F\in\mathcal O(E)_x:|F|_h^2\in L^1_{\mathrm{loc},x}\} \] be its multiplier submodule sheaf. We introduce a finite plurisubharmonic Gram scalarization condition under which the higher-rank integrability problem reduces to finitely many scalar multiplier ideals. This reduction yields coherence and strong openness without imposing a general positivity hypothesis. When the scalar weights and the varying weight have analytic singularities, it also gives a theory of module jumping numbers,…
